discussion.body: Act 8. Open world chapter: polities and recovery. Hub is the airship over the master map. Content: Padon and WillowDale after the shock; Breskshire levy fallout; Constium rail and forge triage; Iunum court sitting in the ash weather; Queen's Cove as a real port. Side: reconstruction boards, hunt marks, local minigames. Story gate (optional to delay): deliver aid to two polities. Does not have to be played before Acts 9-11. No rails. No Nyxara.
